A follow-up to FlyFarmer

  • https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/kaggriculture/discussion/742111
  • https://www.kaggle.com/code/takamichitoda/flyfarmer-connectome-plays-kaggriculture

Rank when I checked: 777th / 10,246. Not final.

Solution

  • A rule-based agent plays the game.
  • Three circuits from the real fly brain (FlyWire) watch the game and step in only when they fire:
    • Startle: cash about to run out → buy fewer seeds
    • Appetite: animal feed running low → pick up more wheat
    • Learning: remembers whether sales went well (no decisions)

The punchline

A shuffled fake brain did just as well once I turned up its sensitivity.

So in the end, this is a rule-based agent with a fly squeezed in. The fly is basically a fancy alarm.
Interesting share! Good work. Can. more startle events create better signals? Very organic :)
